remarks:
Welcome to your own peaceful country retreat, where beautiful updates, comfortable living, and nearby recreation come together on 1.1 picturesque acres. This exceptionally maintained raised ranch offers the tranquility of country living while placing you within walking distance of Allegheny Hills Golf Course and approximately 3 miles from Rushford Lake—perfect for enjoying golfing, boating, fishing, and summer days on the water.

Inside, you'll find warm, inviting living spaces filled with natural light and thoughtful updates throughout. The spacious kitchen and dining area offer plenty of room for everyday living and entertaining, while the primary suite provides a relaxing private retreat complete with a beautifully updated bathroom featuring a luxurious rainfall shower with dual shower heads. An enclosed back entryway adds additional charm and functionality.

Step outside and enjoy a property designed for making the most of country living. Relax around the fire pit, entertain in the spacious yard, enjoy the above-ground pool, or simply take in the peaceful surroundings. A detached two-car garage, additional storage shed, craftsman-built shed, and invisible pet fence provide plenty of added convenience. The pool is negotiable, giving the next owner additional flexibility.

Numerous valuable improvements include newer vinyl siding, new windows, a high-efficiency propane heating and central air system installed in 2024, a new well pump and septic system installed in 2023, hardwired interconnected smoke and carbon monoxide detectors, and baseboard heat in the addition. Additional heating options include two pellet stoves and a wood stove in the basement.

Beautifully maintained, thoughtfully updated, and surrounded by recreation, this move-in-ready property offers so much more than a home—it's a place to enjoy every season. Whether you're looking for peaceful country living, weekends at Rushford Lake, or an afternoon on the golf course, this property puts it all within easy reach. Motivated sellers are ready to make a deal—bring your offer and come see everything this special property has to offer!
